feeds.title: Sailing Wild Horses Blog
feeds.description: We are a Canadian couple living and sailing on our boat, Wild Horses, with our cute and sailboat-ready German Shepherd pup, Ocean. We have left our careers and the colder temps of Ottawa, Ontario behind for new adventures down south.

feeds.title: Distant Shores Blog
feeds.description: Hints and tips for cruising sailors exploring the world by sailboat. We're Paul and Sheryl Shard, a Canadian couple who set sail from Lake Ontario with a dream of sailing south when we were in our early 30's. We have sailed and lived aboard since 1989. We've learned a lot sailing to 'distant shores' on 5 continents over 30 years of international cruising, putting 110,000 miles under the keel and doing 9 ocean crossings during that time.
